▪︎MC cause of lat hip pain in adults; gluteus medius/minimus tendinopathy + inflam of regional bursae
▪︎RFs: ♀, obesity, scoliosis, hip or knee arthritis, plantar fasciitis, LBP
▪︎pain near greater trochanter ⇡ w/ ambulation, prolonged standing/sitting, rising from chair, climbing stairs, lying on affected side; no hx of trauma
▪︎PE: TTP over greater trochanter; pain reproduced w/ movement of the affected hip
» ⊕gram stain of aspirate = diagnostic of septic bursitis

▪︎GTPS: standing AP pelvic XR on all pts (typically nl; r/o other pathology); US: tendonitis + bursitis; MRI: most detail (tendinosis, tendon rupture, muscle atrophy, enthesopathies, effusions)
